project_name: Lewis Hamilton Fan Archive - Immersive Upgrade

headings.style: High-impact, condensed, uppercase, extremely tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em), leading-none.
headings.sizes: H1: text-[12vw] or clamp(4rem, 12vw, 10rem), H2: text-6xl to text-8xl

subheadings.style: Editorial, italicized accents, adds luxury and legacy feel to the racing aggression.

body.style: Clean, geometric, highly legible for deep stats and career records.

accents.name: Ferrari Red
accents.usage: Future transition, aggressive stats, specific 2025 chapter

accents.name: Neon Yellow
accents.usage: High-velocity metrics, hover states, kinetic typography

chapter_themes.strategy: Alternate backgrounds between Black, Off-White, Purple, Red, and Neon Yellow to create emotional pacing as the user scrolls through the 2007-2025 timeline.

visual_enhancers.textures: Heavy noise overlay (opacity 3-5%) across all dark sections to avoid flat digital look. Use SVG grain filters.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp angles, forward-leaning italics, diagonal clipping paths, and asymmetrical masking to simulate speed.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes with 10% opacity for separating dense data tables (stats).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky nav and floating stat cards (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10) - NEVER fully transparent.

components.name: Cinematic Hero
components.rules: Full viewport height. Massive 'HAMILTON' kinetic text in background. Foreground helmet/driver image. Scroll down indicator. Dark overlay max bg-black/40.

components.name: Sticky Season Timeline (2007-2025)
components.rules: Left side pinned timeline (years). Right side scrolls through season data (Wins, Podiums, Poles, Points, Team, Car Image). Fast-paced scroll transition.

components.name: Horizontal Depth Gallery
components.rules: Scroll-triggered horizontal translation for race photography. Images overlap with parallax depth.

components.name: Editorial Collage Layout
components.rules: Bento-style or asymmetrical grid. Overlapping text and images. High-end magazine feel (GQ / Vogue style F1).

components.name: Expanded Victory List
components.rules: Dense, high-contrast data table. Columns: Date, Grand Prix, Grid, Constructor, Points, Laps. Monospace fonts for numbers.

grids_and_layouts.bento: grid-cols-8 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix tall (row-span-2) and wide (col-span-4) cards.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Extremely generous between chapters (py-32 to py-48). Tight within stats grids (gap-2 to gap-4).

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MANDATORY: Lenis smooth scrolling for momentum and weight. GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinned sections and parallax.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Section-to-section transform (opacity reduction, Y-translate, slight X-rotation) mimicking Lando Norris reference.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Images scale up 1.05x, convert from grayscale to color, or reveal elliptical clip-paths via cursor tracking. ALL interactive text MUST change color/opacity.
motion_and_interactions.micro: Magnetic buttons for primary CTAs. Marquee text for quotes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has subtle radial gradient or text-shadow. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: All buttons, links, and forms must have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='timeline-year-2020').

media_and_3d.3d_strategy: If utilizing 3D, use React Three Fiber (R3F) for an abstract F1 wind-tunnel particle effect or rotating helmet, lazy loaded. Otherwise, rely on high-quality 2D assets with parallax depth.
media_and_3d.image_treatment: High contrast. Black and white for legacy/past stats. Full color for milestone victories. Never stretch.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@studio-freight/lenis`, `gsap`, and `framer-motion` for the core scroll momentum.
Implement the Sticky Season Timeline: Use a container with display: flex. The left side is position: sticky, the right side is the scrollable list of seasons 2007-2025.
Implement Alternating Chapters: Apply dynamic background colors (Black -> Off-White -> Purple -> Red -> Neon Yellow) as the user scrolls, matching the content's era or mood.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Anton or Bebas Neue with tight letter spacing for that motorsport speed feel.
Ensure the Expanded Victory List utilizes a monospace font for lap times, points, and grids to align columns perfectly.
Use data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='season-btn-2020', data-testid='victory-row-silverstone').
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on elements that overlay text (like sticky navs). Use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Toasts: Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
